reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: I had a subscription for a long time and it was something like $5 a month with no commercials. I ended up pausing my subscription for about a year and now it’s a tiered subscription with commercials for the lowest level. I don’t think that there are enough movies/ shows in the catalog to warrant such an increase in the fee. It was a fair price for what you get, a very good but limited catalog with no commercials. I just can’t pay $9 a month for this app, it’s not worth it and I refuse to pay for an app that I still have to watch commercials on. I want to think they raised the price because of the new content they’re creating, but I’m sure it’s just corporate greed. Very disappointing. It used to be my favorite app.

reviews.title: Thanks shudder for cutting off millions of your customers with the last update.
reviews.text: As a long time subscriber to your service, I am unbelievably disappointed in your latest update. The fact you’ve knowingly cut off MANY customers and are unwilling to provide a solution or fix. But instead are telling customers the only fix is for them to BUY NEW STREAMING devices!! Seriously?! Shame on you Shudder. And for AMAZON!! Come on. They have enough money - your customers currently don’t. You have lost a very long time customer who up till now had shared your app to anyone who loves horror and doesn’t know about you! Now I will tell everyone to run in the opposite direction. Unbelievable.

reviews.title: Rough Selection of Movies and Poor Rate and Review Interface System
reviews.text:
Ninety percent of the movies I’ve never heard of; they are almost all pretty average. Of course there are a few good or really good movies, though they are by far the exception.

The interface is really tricky for reviewing movies. I only was allowed to review one of the multiple movies that I watched on the app. I think the people behind the app are incredibly protective of the in-app ratings of the movies in the App Library, and allow like a two-second opportunity to rate and review immediately after watching said movie. If you leave the watch screen, you are not allowed to rate and review after going back in to the movie’s ‘page’. Really weird.

reviews.title: Great Content with Lousy App
reviews.text:
Shudder has a small but excellent collection of 100% horror content. This is a review of the app—not the content (which is worth using the lousy app).

The app that plays the content on my Apple TV frequently logs me out and requires the usual annoying login process. This has been a problem for years that they haven't addressed. The addition of downloadable content is welcome but poorly implemented on the IOS app. Movies will delete themselves if you close the app before you finish the movie. 

Compared to other streaming platforms I use, Shudder is the most frustrating app in spite of its fantastic content.

reviews.title: Great Service, Awful App

Constantly drops wifi even when no other video app of mine is having an issue, disconnects repeatedly while trying to cast to my TV and prevents me from casting with anything else until I hard restart my TV (again, something none of my other streaming apps do), never remembers where I was in a movie if I have to pause and return to it later, etc. Makes me sad, as I do love the film selection, but these issues make it completely useless to me.

reviews.title: How could they make it worse?
reviews.text:
This app has always been awful, yet somehow they took it to a new low. 

Now, movies have even shorter descriptions, they don’t tell you the language, nor country of origin, and I have to pull out my phone to know anything about the movies on here.

We pay for a subscription, and effectively never watch anything on it anymore because discovery is too many steps harder.

Collections are now all fire-y looking, and one is indistinguishable from the other. Less information than ever, too.

The app was awful in its previous incarnation, mind you, but I’d take that over the latest version in a heartbeat.

Shudder App recently updated to bring itself more in line with the tiled approach from Netflix et al, and whilst it does look better, it is now no more than just a screen saver as there is NO content available.  Shudder help page is useless and a few internet searches points to a back end issue syncing with Apple devices - Do not subscribe until this is fixed.

reviews.title: The Update is Bad
reviews.text:
I have had Shudder basically since the beginning and seen this platform in a few iterations, but the new update I really don’t understand. I am specifically reviewing the Apple TV app, so I’m not sure if these issues extend to other updates that may have been done to the website or any apps through other devices. I’m still playing around with it, but here are a few things I’ve noticed and hate:

1. The movies no longer tell you what language they are in. They used to show this when you clicked to learn more about the film, but it’s all gone. So now I either have to Google the movie to find out if it’s a foreign film or let it start playing and wait to see what happens. I like a foreign film, but I don’t always want to watch them and so now I’m having to do a lot more work and honestly, it’s making me just not engaged movies that I’m not familiar with.
2. The new descriptions of movies are really bad. We used to get a few sentences about what to expect and it’s now been reduced to a one sentence AI looking summary that don’t even really make sense in some cases. I truly think someone was tasked with taking every summary and throwing it into an AI bought and asking them to change it into a one sentence in summary.
3. The search feature no longer lets you use the microphone option to search for movies. So now I either have to type in what I’m looking for, or go searching for it in one of the categories, or what’s more commonly happening is I will say the movie into the Apple TV

reviews.title: Total service failure - UK app is broken
reviews.text:
Absolutely unacceptable. I have been a loyal UK subscriber for 6 years paying through Apple, yet for the last few days, the app has been completely unusable. Following the "Killer Upgrade" (LOL) migration, the app has failed to recognize my active subscription on both iPhone and Apple TV.

I am logged in, yet titles I am paying for—including licensed UK content like Hellraiser—are covered in padlocks with a "Sign Up" prompt. Reboots, reinstalls, and "Restore Purchase" attempts do absolutely nothing.

The most frustrating part? The community on Reddit is reporting this as a massive sync issue for Apple/Roku users, yet Shudder has left us in the dark for over a week. 

Do not subscribe through the app until they fix the backend "handshake" with Apple. This is a total breach of service.

Fix your sync issues and restore access for paying customers immediately.

reviews.title: I guess info about the movies is too much to ask for.

reviews.title: They canceled the one show that was carrying their entire subscriber base & platform
reviews.text: If they didn’t value the show that brought them virtually their entire subscriber base, then they won’t value you as a subscriber either!  The Last Drive-In with Joe Bob Briggs & Darcy was the one show that encompassed everything a horror fan could want and after 7 seasons of people only subscribing to them for this show…they canceled it…and then the series finale was filled with errors and issues (audio/video out of synch, screen going black every 30 seconds, booting us all out completely at one point, etc.) Then, to make matters even worse they went on X and posted as though they were big fans of both the show and the fans of the show and even posted “Joe Bob Forever!” WHEN THEY WERE THE ONES WHO CANCELLED THE SHOW. Suffice to say, I canceled my subscription immediately and do not recommend them. I will be following Joe Bob and Darcy on whatever network or platform they go to.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Half the time their "new arrivals" have already been free on Tubi for ages. You cannot watch their content on their website, you have to use the app. You have to restart the app on Roku, literally every single time you open it. When you put on an episode of a show to watch, change your mind and try to start a new episode, it says, "too many people are watching" on your account and to try again later. On the Roku app, fast forwarding and rewinding take FOREVER. When you watch ten minutes of something and press "Resume," it starts from the beginning. The only reason I kept my subscription so long was for Joe Bob Briggs and Dragula and the hassle of technical errors and lack of original content is not worth supporting Shudded for me. I am so disappointed with Shudder.
